entities.name: Summit of the Null Moon
entities.description: Gathering of planeswalkers on the Null Moon late in the Ice Age to end the Shard of the Twelve Worlds.

entities.name: Shard of the Twelve Worlds
entities.description: Locked planeswalkers in a small fraction of the multiverse.

entities.name: Faralyn
entities.description: Planeswalker who planned with Tevesh Szat and Leshrac to manipulate others.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: Planeswalker conspirator who escaped the Shard.

entities.name: Chromium Rhuell
entities.description: Elder Dragon in Faralyn's service who died.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: Faralyn's spellsquire; died and was resurrected, then went insane vowing vengeance.

entities.name: Kristina of the Woods
entities.description: Resurrected Ravidel and later cast the World Spell with Freyalise.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Decided with Kristina to cast the World Spell.

entities.name: World Spell
entities.description: Spell that ended the time of the Shard and the Ice Age.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: Plane to which Faralyn and Leshrac planned to escape.

events.summary: Faralyn, Tevesh Szat and Leshrac plan to manipulate the planeswalkers into attacking one another.
events.quote: they would manipulate the present planeswalkers into attacking one another

events.summary: Chromium Rhuell and Ravidel die, releasing energy for Faralyn and Leshrac to escape to Shandalar.
events.quote: which released enough energy for Faralyn and Leshrac to escape

events.summary: Ravidel is resurrected by Kristina and Taysir but goes insane, vowing vengeance.
The Summit leads Freyalise and Kristina to cast the World Spell.
events.quote: it did lead to Freyalise and Kristina deciding to cast the World Spell

relations.quote: an Elder Dragon in Faralyn's service
who was not yet a planeswalker but was Faralyn's spellsquire
